notes.text: Add a text field to each scatter group on the Dashboard when in scatter mode, where the Storyteller can enter a short text string. This string should appear at the bottom of the in-game HUD strip the players use to change their own scatter groups, as a sort of 'title'/'summary' of that group, as written by the ST. This phrase should be stored in the scene library and should persist with the scene.

Add a set of controls for awarding XP to the END phase stage, moving the reminder notifications and Condition-removal notifications to make room.  This control panel should include the following:

- a single button to award 1 XP to each connected player, with "Session attendance" as the description.
- a single button to award 1 XP to all players (even those who are not connected), with "End of Story" as the description.
- a row of buttons, one per player (with not-connected player buttons greyed out) that, when clicked, will award 1 XP to that player, with "Promoted Team Play" as the description
- a row of buttons, one per player (with not-connected player buttons greyed out) that, when clicked, will award 1 XP to that player, with "Compulsion Roleplay" as the description
- a row of buttons, one per player (with not-connected player buttons greyed out) that, when clicked, will award 1 XP to that player, with "Compulsion Resolution" as the description
- a row comprising an integer input field, a text input field, and a single button that, when pressed, will award an amount of XP equal to the amount entered into the integer input field to all players (including non-connected players), with the contents of the text field as the description

Additionally, add a row of buttons to the INTERMISSION phase stage (again making room by moving the reminder notifications), one per player (including non-connected players) that, when clicked, will award 1 XP to that player, with "Provided Feedback" as the description
Right-clicking an NPC token on the stage should not initiate the drag process, but bring up the same popup window that right-clicking a token in the NPC Roster displays.
Dragging an NPC token from anywhere onto a player roll with no set difficulty should filter the displayed difficulty strip to two numbers -- the two "general difficulty" values for the dragged NPC
